name: file-upload
title: File Upload
author: Bevel UI <hello@bevelui.vercel.app>
description: A fully-engineered file upload system with drag-and-drop, per-file progress tracking, validation, error states, retry logic, and cancel support. Consumer-provided upload function keeps it backend-agnostic.
docs: Import from @/components/bevelui/file-upload. Use FileUploadRoot as the provider and supply your own onUpload function. Supports S3, Cloudinary, or any custom endpoint.
